stories.title: Russia-Ukraine war escalates before NATO summit
stories.summary: Russia pounds Kyiv ahead of NATO summit, as Ukraine war returns to center stage amid high-stakes diplomacy.

stories.title: Earthquake-ravaged Venezuela marked its Independence Day yesterday
stories.summary: Venezuela marked its Independence Day amid the aftermath of twin earthquakes and sweeping political change following the U.S.-led removal of Nicolás Maduro.

stories.title: FIFA red card reversal sparks controversy at the World Cup
stories.summary: FIFA lifted a one-match ban against a top U.S. player at the World Cup after President Trump asked for a review. NPR's Scott Detrow talks about the controversy with Franklin Foer of The Atlantic.

stories.title: Get your reading glasses... in the post office
stories.summary: In some towns in India, people working for a non profit approach people who appear to have trouble reading small print to get them hooked up with glasses.

stories.title: Construction workers cope with the challenges of a heatwave
stories.summary: Construction workers don't just stop during the heatwave, they find ways to cope with it. Many work hourly and can't afford not to.

stories.title: Kenya grapples with reduced U.S. aid
stories.summary: Purity Wambui was diagnosed with TB when it was pretty far advanced. It's possible that had health funding from the U.S. not been reduced, the illness may have been caught in time to save her.
